results.answer:
Garden Court 排在前面，是因为它同时满足了两项偏好：记录月租1600新币，在您希望尽量不超过1800新币的范围内；到南洋理工大学的直线距离约1.6公里。

Willow Residence 离学校更近，直线约850米，但记录月租1900新币，比1800新币的期望高出100新币，这项偏好没有达到。

排序是离学校更近和月租尽量不超过1800新币共同作用的结果，不是只看距离，也不是租金越低越靠前。

两套都满足月租不超过3000新币、距学校不超过5000米的必须条件。注意：记录的价格和当前是否可租，还需要联系确认。

results.answer:
Your requirements:
• Rent no more than S$3,000 per month (must meet).
• Within 5km of NTU, measured as straight-line distance (must meet), and preferably closer.
• Ideally rent no more than S$1,800 per month.

What fits:
• Budget: recorded rents are S$1,600 and S$1,900 per month, both under your S$3,000 limit.
• Location: straight-line distances to NTU are about 850m and 1,600m, both within 5km.
• Lower-rent preference: the S$1,600 home meets the S$1,800 target; the S$1,900 home is S$100 above it.

Why this order: both homes meet the must-have conditions, and the order reflects two preferences together — being closer to NTU and keeping rent at or below S$1,800. The first home is closer and also meets the lower-rent target, while the second is farther and slightly above it. The 750m difference is straight-line only; actual walking or commuting differences would need route details.

Note: recorded prices and current availability still need to be confirmed with the agent.
